rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something blindly, whether without sight or without thinking critically.

example.english: I won’t blindly believe online rumors.
example.traditional: 我唔會盲咁信網上啲傳聞。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 wui5 maang4 gam2 seon3 mong5 soeng6 di1 cyun4 man4

rows.note: Use this for literally proceeding in darkness or without being able to see, rather than for uncritical behavior.

example.english: It’s still dark, so we have to hike blindly.
example.traditional: 天仲未光，所以我哋要摸黑咁行山。
example.jyutping: tin1 zung6 mei6 gwong1 so2 ji5 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 mo1 hak1 gam2 haang4 saan1

rows.note: Use this when someone acts randomly or recklessly without considering the consequences.

example.english: Don’t blindly press buttons, or you’ll break the machine.
example.traditional: 你唔好亂咁撳掣，會整壞部機㗎。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 gam6 zai3 wui5 zing2 waai6 bou6 gei1 gaa3
